question_text: Read the passage carefully and complete the table below
stimulus: with information from the passage. 1×5=5 Dr. Muhammad Shahidullah (July 10, 1885-July 13, 1969) was a famous Bengali educationist, writer, philologist and linguist. He was born in the village Peyara, 24 Pargana, West Bengal (now in India). His father Mafizuddin Ahmed was a warden of a Shrine. Muhammad Shahidullah passed his school finals (Known as Entrace examination at that time) in 1904 from Howrah Zilla School. In 1906 he passed the FA exam equivalent to HSC from Presidency College, Kolkata and master of Arts in 1912 in Comparative Philology from the University of Calcutta. He also received a PhD from Sorborne University, France in 1928. Shahidullah's teaching career started in Jessore District School where he taught between 1908 and 1909, He also worked as the Headmaster of Sitakundu High School, Chittagong between 1914 and 1915. He practised law for some time and was elected vice-chairman of Bashirhat municipality. He joined the University of Dhaka as a lecturer of Sanskrit and Bangla in 1921. During his teaching and research career at the Dhaka University, he explored the origins of the Bangla language. subject: English
question_text: The following graph shows comparative selling rates of
stimulus: four types of books in Akushey Boi Mela-2014. Now describe the graph in your own words. 10 SSC English
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart shows the percentage of transportation used by 1500 students to go to school. The right part of the pie chart shows that 45% of students go to school by bicycle. This percentage remains higher than other three types of transportation. The students go by bus and the percentage of the students who go by bus is 20%. It is much less than bicycle transportation. 20% of students go to school by bus and this is really bigger than car. The pie chart also shows the fact that students who go to school on foot which is 15%. On the other hand, only 8% students go to school by car and this percentage is the lowest of all types of transportations used by 1500 students. According to the pie chart we can say that almost 45% of students go to school by bicycle and this indicates that the students go to school from poor families. There are some students who are rich use private cars to go to school. However, this pie chart shows different types of transportations and gives us information that the school has students of poor and rich families.
